description_en: Queries log statistics, such as application error logs, hotword rankings, and slow query logs
description_zh: 查询日志类统计，例如：应用错误日志、热词榜单、慢日志
kebab_example: aliyun opensearch list-statistic-logs --app-group-identity app_group_name --module-name hot --start-time 1582214400 --stop-time 1682222400 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --query default:_OpenSearch --sort-by -id --distinct true --columns wordsTopPv --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListStatisticLogs

parameters.help_en:
The module name. This is an enumeration.

- hot: hotword rankings

- error: application error logs

- slow-log: slow query logs

Currently, only hot is supported
parameters.help_zh:
模块名称，为枚举值

- hot 热词榜单
- error 应用日志
- slow-log 慢日志

目前只支持 hot
parameters.name: module_name

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. The value must be a UNIX timestamp. The default value is the UNIX timestamp for 00:00:00 on the current day
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间
默认为当天0点0分0秒的时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value must be a UNIX timestamp. The default value is the UNIX timestamp for 24:00:00 on the current day
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间
默认为当天24点0分0秒的时间戳
parameters.name: stop_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回数目，默认 pageSize = 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The content of the query clause
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The content of the sort clause
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the distinct clause
parameters.name: distinct

parameters.help_en:
The fields to query. Format: columns=wordsTopPv.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187665.html
parameters.help_zh:
查询的字段
格式为 columns=wordsTopPv

参考：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187665.html
parameters.name: columns
